title: Outsider (Poppy Playtime)
blurb: Poppy Playtime built its identity on toys that should not be moving, and the audio does more work than the monsters do. Mob Entertainment's factory is all long corridors and nursery colours, so the score has to carry the dread while you are staring at something bright pink. This clip sits in that register: slow and deliberately paced, with no interest in hurrying you along. Editors use it for the moment the camera stops being playful. Good for setting a mood before anything has actually happened on screen.
origin: A track associated with Mob Entertainment's Poppy Playtime series.
